//: sdk: pins the major .NET version so every machine and build agent compiles
allows newer 10.x SDKs without silently moving to .NET 11.
test.runner: opts into the Microsoft.Testing.Platform mode of 'dotnet test',
introduced in the .NET 10 SDK. xunit.v3 is an MTP test application, and the
.NET 10 SDK no longer supports running MTP through the legacy VSTest path.
Without this, 'dotnet test' fails before a single test runs.
